links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 rewritten discharge summaries (Fernández-Huerta, INFLESZ) versus originals
links.effect: Significant readability improvement across all diagnostic groups (p < .001), with mean values above recommended thresholds; five summaries remained below thresholds.
links.quote: Significant improvements in readability were observed across all diagnostic groups (p < .001), with mean values surpassing recommended thresholds for general comprehension.

links.outcome: Psychiatrist-rated emotional risk and language appropriateness of AI-rewritten summaries
links.effect: Summaries were rated positively overall, but evaluators noted emotionally charged or stigmatizing language in a few cases.
links.quote: Evaluators also highlighted emotionally charged or stigmatizing language in a few cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance and readability of ChatGPT-4 in rewriting psychiatric discharge summaries using retrospective anonymized cases evaluated by psychiatrists, without testing a specific operational deployment guardrail or practice.
